backtest._note: max_parallel_pairs bounds how many (strategy x symbol) backtests run at once. engine.run() is pandas/numpy work that holds the GIL in bursts; firing every pair at once (thousands of asyncio.to_thread tasks) starved the event loop so badly the 2s order monitor fell to one cycle per ~24s and the DB pool timed out (INV_C8 'DB unreachable', 2026-08-28 21:31). Keep this well below the CPU count so live monitoring always gets loop time.

idempotency._note: Durable duplicate-order guard (src/execution/idempotency.py, table order_intents). mode: off | shadow | enforce. shadow (default) records every entry-order attempt and LOGS an exact duplicate (same signal/symbol/side/qty/price still PENDING or SUBMITTED inside window_seconds) but never blocks anything. enforce additionally refuses that exact duplicate. A previous FAILED attempt, or one older than window_seconds, never blocks -- window_seconds (120) is deliberately shorter than the 5-minute same-day AMO retry interval, so genuine retries always go through. A guard/DB error or timeout always fails OPEN. Review 'idempotency_duplicate_detected' logs in shadow for a while before enabling enforce.

flattrade._note: RISK PARAMETER. Flattrade API orders are LMT / SL-LMT only (market orders are blocked for API orders, Phase 0 findings A1/C-4). The adapter sends MARKET as a marketable LIMIT at LTP*(1+band) for BUY (rounded UP to tick) / LTP*(1-band) for SELL (rounded DOWN), clamped inside the circuit limits, and SL-M as SL-LMT with limit = trigger*(1+band) BUY / trigger*(1-band) SELL. market_protection_band_pct is a FRACTION: 0.005 = 0.5%. It is the worst slippage accepted beyond LTP/trigger; wider fills more reliably in a fast market (a gap through the band leaves the stop UNFILLED as a resting limit), narrower limits slippage. Allowed range (0, 0.05]; anything else stops the adapter from starting.
